DATA MANAGEMENT

Snapshot of the active class: which school, grade & section, subject, and school year are loaded, and how complete the encoded record is (scores, attendance, and assessment weights).

B. CLASSES / SECTIONS

Each chip below is one Grade + Section + Subject record with its own roster, scores, attendance, assessment configuration, and reports. Click a chip to open it.
Add class opens the wizard and creates the record only when you confirm. Duplicate makes a full copy (learners, LRNs & birthdays, scores, attendance, summaries config) under a new Grade + Section + Subject. No Grade + Section + Subject may repeat.

Re-key the selected chip (rename only — never creates or switches classes)
GRADE: SECTION: SUBJECT:

If the new key already exists, the change is blocked and the previous value is kept.

C. CLASS RECORD PROFILE (HEADER)

This header appears at the top of every official form you print — Class Records, SF9, Grade Slips, Attendance, and Individual Reports. Fill the school, division, district, address, School ID, school year, adviser, and position correctly.

D. LEARNERS' ROSTER (one name per line) — active class

Paste names, LRNs, and birthdays in the same order (one per line). Birthday is used to compute age on SF9. Formats: 2013-06-15, 06/15/2013, or 15/06/2013.

E. TERM CONFIGURATION & ASSESSMENT COMPONENTS

Choose the term you are configuring and set how its grade is computed: Written Works, Performance Tasks, and (where used) Examinations must add up to 100%. This matches your school's assessment plan.

Total: 100% ✓ Component weights per term must total 100%.

F. SIGNATORY INFORMATION (labels editable · show/hide)

These are the people who sign the printed reports — typically Prepared by (the adviser), Noted by (head teacher), and Approved by (school head). Edit each label, name, and position, and tick whether each line prints.

G. ADVANCED — CHANGE HISTORY (LOCAL AUDIT LOG)

Every change you make is recorded here with the time it happened. It helps you spot accidental edits. The Clear Log button only erases this history display.

H. FOOTER LINE (BOTTOM OF PAGES)

The small footer line that appears at the bottom of every page. Make it smaller, hide it, or change its wording. It is included when the page is printed or saved as PDF.
